# SciSpace

> > SciSpace provides academic manuscript templates and formatting tools for researchers submitting to journals from publishers like Zibeline International Publishing, Springer, Elsevier, Wiley, Taylor and Francis, and Nature.

SciSpace offers a comprehensive collection of journal-specific templates and citation styles, supporting both LaTeX and MS-Word formats. The platform helps researchers format manuscripts according to publisher guidelines from major academic publishers and institutions worldwide, streamlining the submission process for academic publishing.

## Key Topics

- Journal templates
- Citation styles
- Manuscript formatting
- Academic publishing
- Zibeline International Publishing
- Research paper formatting

## Zibeline International Publishing Templates

- [Journal Of Healthcare In Developing Countries (JHCDC) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/journal-of-healthcare-in-developing-countries-jhcdc/eef2a7e7ca3d4bf5b134d8b68861d3ba): JHCDC journal template for Zibeline Publishing with formatting tools
- [Economic Growth and Environment Sustainability (EGNES) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/economic-growth-and-environment-sustainability-egnes/12a8d4b771634355b5438e156e7d56bd): EGNES journal template for Zibeline Publishing manuscript formatting
- [Acta Chemica Malaysia (ACMY) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/acta-chemica-malaysia-acmy/53fa8d62d4714ceda78ac7ca57213a8f): ACMY chemistry journal template for Zibeline Publishing submissions
- [Information Management and Computer Science (IMCS) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/information-management-and-computer-science-imcs/38a842a2fd1442308c5c34929505fad5): IMCS computer science journal template for Zibeline Publishing
- [Advances in Culture and Arts (ACA) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/advances-in-culture-and-arts-aca/76a15ae8c2c64dec8a2fdc8418411d2c): ACA culture and arts journal template for Zibeline Publishing

## Academic Institution Templates

- [Fashion Institute of Technology - Templates | SciSpace](https://scispace.com/formats/fashion-institute-of-technology): Fashion Institute of Technology dissertation and journal templates
- [Revista de etnografie si folclor Template - Academia Romana](https://scispace.com/formats/academia-romana/revista-de-etnografie-si-folclor/fcd2c785f8ba4cac8c964e4f265f9eae): Academia Romana ethnography and folklore journal template
- [Studii si cercetari lingvistice Template - Academia Romana](https://scispace.com/formats/academia-romana/studii-si-cercetari-lingvistice/46b3c411210a45d1a7bf163921c845a3): Academia Romana linguistics journal template with citation tools
- [JUSTIAN - Jurnal Sistem Informasi Akuntansi Template - Universitas Bina Sarana Informatika](https://scispace.com/formats/universitas-bina-sarana-informatika/justian-jurnal-sistem-informasi-akuntansi/509dc085b35342eb97cef2a10c7a0e33): JUSTIAN accounting information systems journal template

## Publisher-Specific Templates

- [Growth and Form (GAF) Template - Atlantis Press](https://scispace.com/formats/atlantis-press/growth-and-form-gaf/712392e9f0904806953faf2511f1868a): Growth and Form journal template for Atlantis Press submissions
